sourceObservation.method: Fresh official checklist UI reads through native Safari accessibility controls. Each sport/year/brand/program was selected and Download Full Checklist was clicked. Original UTF-8 CSV files were read from the filenames displayed in Safari Downloads; bytes are retained unchanged.

sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 4,502 rows from the official Panini CSV export are retained, including all original columns, literal card-set parallel names and SEQUENCE values. Empty numbering is not an estimate. Pack odds are absent from this export. Product year does not establish a release date. This export was observed in the official interface on 2026-10-18; that observation is not a release date. Printed card-set identities naming other products are retained. Full product-guide and calendar-release reconciliation remain pending.
